before_any_write.PINS_MISMATCH: migration bytes/apply SQL/ledger rows/cli_parser/baseline/certified Staging tooling differ
before_any_write.ARTIFACT_MISMATCH: function files or metadata differ from the certified Staging deploy
before_any_write.PAT_REFUSED: missing/malformed PAT or PAT carrying a ref
before_any_write.PREFLIGHT_AMBIGUOUS: any unreadable or unexpected API answer
before_any_write.MIGRATION_STATE_STOP: decision table STOP or order violation
before_any_write.APP_PRIVATE_UNEXPECTED: app_private pre-existing or not the exact contract set
before_any_write.PREFLIGHT_STATE_CHANGED: state moved between preflight and phrase
before_any_write.WRITER_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE: PAT cannot write as postgres (first request after arming, a SELECT)

after_writes_began.APPLY_FAILED: server rolled back that transaction; re-observe

every_stop: persisted (core-prod-preflight-failed-* / core-prod-failed-*), secret-gated, no automatic rollback; next step is --preflight-only
